manage.description: Everyone you have entered on flights, trips and rides. Make spellings consistent, merge two entries for the same person and delete the ones you no longer need.

manage.inUseHint: In use – merge with another person to remove.

rename.taken: {{name}} already exists. Is it the same person? Then merge the two.

merge.nothing: {{source}} is on no entry and will only be deleted.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.body: {{name}} is on no entry and will be removed from your list for good.

deleteUnused.body_other: {{count}} people are on no entry, paid nothing and are linked to no account. Deleting removes these names from your list for good.
